sources.title: OrientedDet Documentation - dl4eo.github.io
sources.snippet: OrientedDet is a lightweight, modern PyTorch library for rotated object detection in aerial and satellite imagery. It focuses on clean geometry, reliable operators, simple datasets, and practical baseline models — without the complexity of large detection frameworks.

sources.title: Announcing the Oriented R-CNN 3× pretrained model
sources.snippet: We finished training and evaluation of Oriented R-CNN 3× on DOTA le90. With it, the OrientedDet pretrained zoo on Hugging Face (dl4eo/oriented-det-pretrained) is complete for our three detector families: Oriented R-CNN, Rotated Faster R-CNN, and Rotated RetinaNet.
